concerns.text: The plan’s Constitution Check claims that “All external citations are limited to the verified URLs listed in the spec (Box2D metadata, metric datasets).” However, the spec’s research.md marks the SSIM, PSNR, LPIPS, and FID implementations as having “No verified source.” This contradicts Principle II (Verified Accuracy) of the constitution, which requires that every external citation be verified. The statement is therefore inaccurate and violates the constitution.
